## Pull request overview > [!NOTE] > Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review. This PR migrates the repo’s dev + CI workflow from a “build/pull monolithic devcontainer” model to a mise-first workflow, with an optional dedicated RISC-V toolchain container for C++/riscv-tests. **Changes:** - Replaces CI “build-container + download/load docker_image” with a composite `mise-setup` action for consistent tool + dependency installation. - Adds a dedicated `.toolchain` container and wrapper scripts to optionally run compilers/tools inside that container (`UDB_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER=1`). - Refactors `bin/*` wrappers and docs to run via `mise exec` and introduces `bin/doctor` + git hook installer. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 16 out of 59 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tools/test/regress-tests.yaml | Adds per-test `toolchain_container` flag; simplifies sorbet invocation for mise-based CI. | | tools/test/regress-gh-template.yaml | Removes build-container job; switches jobs to mise setup; keeps “never-runs” for version pinning. | | tools/test/gen_regress.rb | Generates workflows using `mise-setup`, including conditional toolchain container setup. | | tests/isa/Makefile | Ensures RISC-V toolchain binaries are discoverable via PATH/prefix variables. | | do | Switches task runner to `mise exec` and supports `.toolchain-local` preference. | | bin/udb-gen | Runs udb-gen via mise/bundler using the gem’s Gemfile. | | bin/udb | Runs udb via mise/bundler using the gem’s Gemfile. | | bin/setup | Removes legacy container runtime orchestration; keeps Z3 setup; delegates hook installation to `bin/install_hooks`. | | bin/run | Deletes legacy “run inside dev container” helper (container model removed). | | bin/ruby | Wraps ruby execution via mise while preserving original working directory. | | bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container objdump. | | bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container gcc. | | bin/riscv32-unknown-elf-objdump | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container objdump (rv32 via rv64 objdump in container). | | bin/riscv32-unknown-elf-gcc | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container gcc (rv32 via rv64 gcc flags natively). | | bin/reuse | Runs reuse (python) via mise/uv. | | bin/regress | Updates regress CLI runner invocation (no longer sources setup). | | bin/rdbg | Runs rdbg via mise. | | bin/rake | Runs rake via mise. | | bin/python | Runs python via mise/uv. | | bin/prek | Runs prek via mise. | | bin/npx | Runs npx via mise. | | bin/npm | Runs npm via mise. | | bin/node | Runs node via mise. | | bin/make | Runs make via mise. | | bin/install_hooks | New script to install git hooks and auto-run `mise install` on `.mise.toml` changes. | | bin/idlc | Updates idlc runner to use gem Gemfile (no longer container). | | bin/generate | Switches shebang to /bin/bash to align with other wrappers. | | bin/gdb | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container gdb. | | bin/g++ | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container g++. | | bin/doctor | New environment diagnostics tool for mise + deps + optional toolchain container. | | bin/container/udb-gen | Removes legacy bundler-generated container shim. | | bin/container/udb | Removes legacy bundler-generated container shim. | | bin/container/idlc | Removes legacy bundler-generated container shim. | | bin/clobber | Updates clean targets for new workflow (but currently contains conflict markers). | | bin/clean | Switches shebang to /bin/bash. | | bin/clang-tidy | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container clang-tidy. | | bin/clang-format | New wrapper selecting native vs toolchain container clang-format. | | bin/chore | Refactors subcommands for new container targets and removes container-tag bumping flow; runs ruby tasks directly. | | bin/bundle | Runs bundler via mise. | | bin/bash | Runs bash via mise. | | bin/asciidoctor | Runs asciidoctor via mise + bundler. | | bin/.toolchain.sh | New shared helper for toolchain container runtime + native compiler checks. | | bin/.functions.sh | Removes legacy container selection/build helper library. | | bin/.container-tag | Removes old manually-managed devcontainer tag. | | bin/.chore/update.sh | Switches shebang to /bin/bash. | | bin/.chore/helpers.sh | Replaces tag/version helpers with content-hash-based tagging and runtime detection. | | bin/.chore/container.sh | Adds `-t devcontainer|toolchain` targeting; computes tags by content hash; uses docker/podman runtime. | | backends/cpp_hart_gen/tasks.rake | Routes formatting through wrapper; passes UDB root to CMake; sets RISCV_PREFIX for riscv-tests build. | | backends/cpp_hart_gen/CMakeLists.txt | Centralizes C++ requirement checks into `.toolchain/check_cxx.cmake`. | | README.adoc | Documents mise-native setup, hooks install, and doctor command. | | .toolchain/check_cxx.cmake | New single source of truth for required C++ features (C++23 + concepts + constexpr from_chars). | | .toolchain/Dockerfile | New toolchain container building GCC toolset 14 + riscv-gnu-toolchain from source. | | .mise.toml | Adds `make` tool to mise-managed toolchain. | | .gitignore | Ignores `.toolchain-local` preference file. | | .github/workflows/toolchain-container.yml | New workflow to publish toolchain container images by Dockerfile hash. | | .github/workflows/regress.yml | Regenerates regress workflow to use mise-setup; removes devcontainer image artifact plumbing. | | .github/workflows/nightly.yml | Updates nightly to use mise-setup. | | .github/actions/mise-setup/action.yml | New composite action for mise install + dependency caches + optional toolchain container pull/build. | | .devcontainer/Dockerfile | Removes copying gem binstubs into container; relies on mise/bundle execution model. |

Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1) **tools/test/gen_regress.rb:1** * The workflow generator now reaches into a specific job (`regress-llvm`) and a positional step (`steps[0]`) to find the checkout action. This is brittle: reordering steps or renaming the job in the template will break generation. Prefer either hardcoding the checkout action ref in the generator, or locating the step by `name`/`uses` match (e.g., find the step that starts with `actions/checkout@`).
